column1: b01.0|Let's demo the completed CSV flow Monday and schedule Excel after its remaining work is reviewed. I'll confirm that CSV meets the demo's actual need.|I'll move both formats to next week so the client sees one complete export experience rather than an interim limitation.|I'll keep Excel on Friday's target and ask engineering to overlap testing with implementation, using the weekend only if the client needs it.|Demo value и full release различаются. Overlap требует оценки; готовый CSV полезен при согласованной потребности, не автоматически.

b02.0|I'll validate the renewal need and reusable demand, estimate a minimum option and make the displaced roadmap work explicit before committing the eight-percent account.|I'll prioritize the dashboard because eight percent of revenue is material, asking engineering to fit it around the existing quarterly commitments.|I'll decline custom development to protect the roadmap, offering the client the current reporting product.|Material revenue требует разговора, не автоматического yes. Roadmap — выбор, не запрет пересмотра; нужен полный opportunity cost.

b03.0|Four days and six hundred users don't establish precision alone. I'll compare the result with the planned sample, interval and guardrails before giving a decision recommendation.|I'll extend for two weeks and launch if conversion still leads, treating a longer duration as sufficient evidence.|I'll roll out gradually because four-percent lift is commercially valuable, using post-launch conversion as the confirmation of the early test.|Sample count без baseline/MDE/variance не даёт вывода. Longer не автоматически valid; decision threshold и stopping rule задают заранее.

b04.0|The interviews suggest interest, not validated willingness to pay. I'll test a concrete offer with price and commitment before funding the full feature.|I'll build a small beta and ask the five enthusiastic users for payment after they have experienced the finished workflow.|I'll launch a pricing survey to the same five users and use their stated maximum price as the validated demand estimate.|Stated preference слабее реального commitment. Beta может дать learning, но scope и success criteria нужны до build.

b05.0|I'll validate DAU tracking and definitions, then segment traffic and engagement around the campaign pause and release before assigning cause.|I'll ask engineering to inspect Tuesday's release first, since the drop follows a product change and rollback might restore activity.|I'll attribute the decline to reduced acquisition and ask marketing to resume the campaign before checking returning-user engagement.|Temporal order не causal proof. Нужно отделить acquisition mix от активности существующих users и tracking error.

b06.0|Let's clarify the changed business need, quantify rework and agree a decision owner and cutoff, with explicit scope/date options for the remaining five weeks.|I'll freeze all requirements now and defer marketing's new ideas until after launch, protecting the designers from further disruption.|I'll accept the latest brief as final and ask design to absorb the changes, documenting the history for the retrospective.|Change control должен разрешать осознанный trade-off. Freeze полезен как agreed gate, не безусловный запрет; rework не исчезает от слова final.

b07.0|I'll assess critical support readiness and launch risk, then offer a smaller supported rollout or revised announcement with named owners for the gaps.|I'll keep the announced full launch and add temporary support hours, finishing the remaining forty percent of articles during the first week.|I'll postpone the whole launch until every article is complete and every agent returns, regardless of which journeys need support coverage.|Readiness зависит от severity, coverage и demand. Ни public date, ни формальные 100% docs не заменяют risk-based go/no-go.

b08.0|I'll compare the twelve requests against retention impact, evidence, effort and dependencies, then publish the top three and the trade-offs with owners.|I'll give sales, support and design one slot each, ensuring the three available commitments reflect all major stakeholder perspectives.|I'll rank by estimated retention lift alone and commit the highest three, asking engineering to manage effort differences inside the quarter.|Equal slots не value. Lift без confidence, effort и dependencies может дать недостижимый roadmap.

b09.0|I'll compare two-year total cost, exit terms and alternatives, then negotiate commitment and payment conditions against our actual budget and flexibility needs.|I'll take the ten-percent discount because the product is important and two years reduces the risk of another price increase.|I'll keep the annual contract even if it costs more, treating flexibility as more valuable than any long-term saving without calculating scenarios.|Discount не free saving при lock-in. Flexibility тоже имеет цену; нужен like-for-like TCO и реальные условия выхода.

b10.0|Q4 is a planning window, not a confirmed date. I'll give the client that status and a dated estimation update before promising delivery.|I'll quote the last day of Q4 as the exact date, adding a reasonable-efforts clause until engineering finishes its estimate.|I'll avoid discussing timing altogether until engineering confirms a release day, leaving Ben to manage the client relationship meanwhile.|Честный диапазон и следующий checkpoint полезнее ложной точности или молчания. Disclaimer не превращает неизвестный срок в commitment.

s01.0|Let's take the verified ten-minute rollback if it's data-safe, communicate the impact and test the fix before another rollout.|I'll approve the small hotfix after a second engineer reads it, keeping rollback ready if payment failures remain above five percent.|I'll wait for engineering to confirm root cause completely before choosing recovery, so we don't revert a release that merely correlates with the failure.|Recovery и root cause разные задачи. Если rollback проверен, ongoing $3k/hour harm важнее ожидания идеального объяснения; review не staging test.

s01.1|We'll say checkout is affected, rollback is underway and give the next update time, keeping recovery ETA and payment safety conditional on verified evidence.|I'll tell customers the issue is fixed because rollback has started, then correct the status if monitoring shows remaining failures.|I'll apologize and promise every failed order will be recovered automatically, reducing support anxiety while engineering restores the service.|Начатый rollback не recovery. Нельзя гарантировать восстановление orders или денег без reconciliation; нужен ясный актуальный status.

s02.0|I'll clarify the must-have workflow and deal probability, then compare an assessed slice or partner option with the work displaced from this quarter.|I'll fund A from the maintenance allocation to protect the $500k deal, treating feature revenue as higher priority than internal work.|I'll ask sales to close the deal first and promise the feature afterward, avoiding roadmap churn for a prospect that may not sign.|Revenue estimate требует probability и cost. Нельзя менять maintenance risk молча или обещать невозможную дату ради подписи.

s02.1|Let's quantify the payments-refactor exposure and compare the smallest A scope with a safe baseline, making any accepted delay an explicit risk-owned decision.|I'll postpone the refactor one month because it has no immediate customer-facing output, preserving the committed sales opportunity.|I'll reject feature A categorically because payment work outranks commercial features regardless of current controls and quantified risk.|Debt не автоматически second-class, security не автоматически infinite priority. Нужен конкретный risk-adjusted trade-off и полномочия.

s03.0|I'll define the affected cohorts, customer notices, revenue and retention horizons, and guardrails, then test a lawful limited price change before broader commitment.|I'll test the new price on a small random group without notice and judge success by immediate revenue per user.|I'll survey customers about the fifteen-percent increase and use the stated acceptance rate as the launch forecast for next month.|Price experiment требует consumer/contract review. Short-term RPU и stated willingness не покрывают churn, margin и законные обязанности.

s03.1|I'll check contribution margin, cohort comparability and mature churn against the plan before rollout; higher revenue per user alone doesn't settle the retention trade-off.|I'll launch because nine-percent higher revenue per user more than offsets two-percent lower conversion, assuming the percentages can be netted directly.|I'll cancel because any conversion decline means the price test failed, keeping revenue gains out of the success decision.|Разные denominators нельзя просто вычесть. Conversion, ARPU, margin и retention требуют совместной модели и достаточного horizon.

b11.0|I'll report the sign-up gain separately from unchanged week-four retention, inspect cohort quality and activation, and avoid calling the campaign a retention win.|I'll call it a successful acquisition campaign and leave retention out of the board headline because marketing only controls sign-ups.|I'll stop the campaign because flat retention proves the additional sign-ups are low-intent users who do not create value.|Flat rate при большей cohort может означать больше retained users в абсолюте. Без cost и incrementality нет полного verdict.

b12.0|I'll investigate why contact import causes abandonment and who needs its downstream value, then test deferral or an alternative with privacy and activation guardrails.|I'll remove contact import for everyone because fewer onboarding steps generally improve conversion, preserving the feature only for existing customers.|I'll retain the step and add a progress indicator, assuming clearer expectations resolve the trust and relevance concern without research.|Drop location не причина. Deferral подходит, если сохраняет value и data permissions; visual polish может лечить другой symptom.

b13.0|I'll compare debt's measured delivery and incident costs with the three promises, then agree targeted remediation and explicit feature trade-offs.|I'll grant two full sprints and leave the sales roadmap unchanged, expecting the resulting speed improvement to recover the lost time later.|I'll defer debt until all promised features ship, treating external commitments as fixed and internal maintenance as flexible by definition.|Будущая productivity не гарантирует catch-up. Нужны evidence, scope и согласованные приоритеты, а не двойное обещание capacity.

b14.0|Let's choose a defined onboarding outcome, baseline, cohort window and guardrails, then agree a measurable target and owner before designing the solution.|I'll set a twenty-percent activation increase as the objective, giving the team a clear number even though the baseline isn't confirmed.|I'll measure the number of onboarding improvements shipped, since that is the output product can directly control this quarter.|Objective не список outputs. Произвольный target не evidence-based; activation требует конкретного value event и окна.

b15.0|I'll validate the speed-focused customer need and assess a narrower four-week release, making exclusions and quality gates explicit before changing the ten-week plan.|I'll match the competitor's full feature in four weeks and ask engineering to use the existing implementation as the design reference.|I'll keep the original ten-week scope unchanged because a competitor announcement doesn't alter our already approved roadmap.|Competition — новая evidence, не приказ копировать. Возможен меньший solution к той же потребности; estimate надо проверить.

b16.0|I'll check who asked, eligible-user reach and the underlying accessibility or usage need, then compare two weeks of work with other evidence-backed opportunities.|I'll prioritize dark mode because ten independent support requests in a week demonstrate strong recurring demand.|I'll reject dark mode because only ten customers requested it, using request count alone as evidence that the feature is niche.|Request count без denominator и segment impact не priority. Accessibility может иметь вес независимо от majority demand.

b17.0|Let's compare both candidates against the role's agreed craft and collaboration criteria, resolve evidence gaps and record the decision.|I'll hire Mia because stronger craft is harder to teach, assigning a mentor to improve collaboration after she joins.|I'll hire Jonas because team harmony is the deciding factor whenever a panel is tied on two candidates.|Ни skill hierarchy, ни harmony не универсальны. Role need и structured evidence важнее split vote; недостающий signal проверяют адресно.

b18.0|I'll align sales and engineering on an assessed three-week core scope, explicitly defer the rest and confirm acceptance with the client before renewing the promise.|I'll ask engineering to divide the six-week estimate by two and use parallel work to preserve the full promised feature.|I'll move the deadline to six weeks because engineering estimated the whole scope, ignoring the client's stated flexibility about what ships.|Scope flexibility — шанс найти feasible outcome. Parallelism требует capacity и dependency analysis, не деления календаря.

b19.0|I'll start from the reporting problem, compare AI and simpler fixes against customer value, feasibility and risk, and give the board a justified investment choice.|I'll choose one AI idea for a small launch so the board can see market responsiveness while we investigate slow reporting separately.|I'll reject both AI ideas because users asked for faster reports rather than AI, treating their wording as a solution constraint.|Customer problem не запрещает технологию, но buzzword не оправдание. Нужно сравнить outcomes, cost и риски вариантов.

b20.0|I'll model free-to-paid cohorts, marginal infrastructure cost and acquisition value, then test targeted limits or conversion changes before removing the free plan.|I'll remove free access because thirty percent of infrastructure cost is too large, offering a trial to preserve sign-ups.|I'll keep the free plan unchanged because it generates most sign-ups, using acquisition volume as proof it pays for itself.|Cost share не unit economics, sign-ups не profit. Нужны incremental acquisition, conversion и serviced-cohort cost.

b21.0|Weekly customers completing an intended banking task is a plausible value metric; I'll define success, validate its outcome link and retain financial and quality guardrails.|I'll choose monthly revenue alone because every product action eventually needs to support business sustainability.|I'll choose total registered users because it gives all teams a consistent cumulative number and is less volatile than weekly activity.|North-star metric должен отражать банковскую customer value. Нужно определить intended task и success; time spent, cumulative registrations и одна revenue не заменяют проверки delivered value.

b22.0|I'll show interruption costs and agree one prioritization route with sales, a bounded urgent-work policy and explicit swaps when commitments change.|I'll freeze sprint scope completely and ask the VP of Sales to wait until the next planning meeting for every new request.|I'll reserve half the sprint for sales requests, preserving flexibility without requiring product and engineering to discuss individual trade-offs.|Buffer следует evidence, не arbitrary 50%. Urgent exceptions бывают, но должны иметь owner, cost и displaced work.

b23.0|I'll examine ticket severity, exposure and margin alongside the conversion interval and predefined guardrails before recommending a fix, limited release or no launch.|I'll launch because conversion is the primary metric and handle the fifteen-percent ticket increase by adding temporary support capacity.|I'll reject the variant because any increase in support tickets means the improved conversion was achieved through a worse experience.|Количество tickets требует denominator и severity. Ни primary metric, ни один guardrail signal без rule не дают универсального решения.

b24.0|I'll ask what they do with exported data, inspect the spreadsheet workflow and test the smallest useful interchange before specifying a general export button.|I'll add a CSV button because two customers already copy tables into spreadsheets, using that format as the confirmed requirement.|I'll design a full reporting workspace instead of export, assuming customers really want to stop using spreadsheets altogether.|Workflow определяет need и constraints. Запрос кнопки не доказывает format, а vision продукта не разрешает игнорировать external tools.

b25.0|I'll flag the unapproved pricing claim now and coordinate legal-safe wording or a revised send date; an announced launch doesn't authorize a misleading price statement.|I'll send the email with a pricing disclaimer and let Legal correct the landing page afterward if the wording needs changes.|I'll cancel all launch activity automatically, even if Legal can approve a verified neutral message without pricing details.|Legal gate нельзя обойти footnote. Минимальный safe communication возможен после approval, а не blanket cancellation.

b26.0|I'll clarify what the extra design week protects and assess a verified smaller flow, with design and engineering agreeing the release's actual acceptance risk.|I'll tell design to release the current screens because the client date is already promised and design can iterate next week.|I'll grant design the additional week and update the launch target, preserving the intended complete experience for the waiting client.|Quality concern требует конкретики и trade-off. PM не подменяет expertise, но должен связать scope, risk и commitments.

b27.0|I'll understand the renewal-critical outcome, explain the current prioritization evidence and explore a credible workaround or assessed option without making an unscoped promise.|I'll promise the request before renewal to protect a three-year relationship, then ask engineering to find capacity later.|I'll send the roadmap score and decline further discussion, since transparent scoring already explains why the feature was not selected.|Долгая relationship не безусловный roadmap slot. Scorecard не заменяет диалог о need и risk конкретного клиента.

b28.0|I'll check NPS sampling and segments alongside complaints and leading indicators; stable retention doesn't prove the decline harmless or identify its cause.|I'll wait for retention to fall before prioritizing investigation, since customer behavior is more reliable than a survey score.|I'll launch a broad satisfaction initiative immediately and treat the eleven-point NPS drop as evidence of worsening product usability.|Survey может быть early signal или sampling change. Нужны composition и drivers, а не автоматическое игнорирование или diagnosis.

b29.0|I'll ask which current outcomes the rewrite unlocks, compare targeted fixes and migration risk, and set measurable milestones before trading away the two quick wins.|I'll approve the rewrite because search is foundational and cleaner architecture will make all future feature work faster.|I'll reject non-feature work this quarter because customers cannot directly see a search-module rewrite in release notes.|Architecture не ценность сама по себе. Но hidden reliability и delivery constraints тоже customer impact; нужны evidence и alternatives.

b30.0|I'll clarify the client's need and Mark's commitment, obtain an estimate and agree feasible scope/date options together before communicating a corrected promise.|I'll honor the two-week promise this time and move another data-team task, protecting trust while coaching Mark privately afterward.|I'll tell the client Mark lacked authority and withdraw the commitment, leaving sales to rebuild confidence with the correct roadmap.|Ни unilateral honor, ни blame не разрешают capacity. Нужно ownership общего исправления и будущий commitment rule.

s04.0|I'll establish the account's actual SSO requirement, deadline flexibility and wider demand, then compare an assessed solution with the roadmap and renewal risk.|I'll prioritize SSO immediately because twelve percent of revenue is too large to risk, asking engineering to preserve the rest of the quarter afterward.|I'll hold the existing roadmap and offer a discount instead, assuming commercial compensation can replace an enterprise security requirement.|SSO может быть обязательным control, а не negotiable preference. Значимость клиента требует discovery и explicit trade-off, не двойного обещания.

s04.1|Let's validate an existing identity-provider integration, narrow requirements or a phased agreement, with security-reviewed feasibility before promising a four-week SSO outcome.|I'll promise a limited internal SSO prototype in four weeks and describe it as the customer's requested production integration.|I'll offer manual account provisioning as equivalent to SSO, reducing development effort while leaving the client's security requirement unchanged.|Prototype и provisioning не production SSO. Нужны protocol, lifecycle и acceptance; альтернативу должен принять customer/security owner.

s05.0|I'll distinguish eligible reach, discovery, activation and repeat value, inspect instrumentation and talk to relevant non-users before interpreting five-percent adoption.|I'll send another newsletter and measure click-through, assuming awareness is the bottleneck because the feature lives in settings.|I'll remove the feature because five-percent adoption after a month is too low to justify ongoing support and maintenance.|Одна adoption rate не verdict. Newsletter не гарантирует awareness; отбор толькоusers скрывает причины non-use.

s05.1|Let's test a more discoverable entry point for eligible users, measuring successful use and retention with fatigue and task-completion guardrails.|I'll move the feature onto the home screen for everyone and use the first week's clicks as proof we fixed adoption.|I'll keep it in settings and send contextual email reminders, avoiding any change to the main product navigation.|Visibility — подтверждённая проблема, но click не delivered value. Placement и reminders сравнивают по real use и side effects.

s06.0|I'll acknowledge the missing explanation and convene a focused design-engineering review around the user goal, constraints and assessable alternatives.|I'll ask engineering to document the rejection and let Oleg redesign independently, preserving the team's current sprint work.|I'll approve Oleg's original design because rejecting it without explanation undermines collaboration, leaving feasibility to engineering implementation.|Respect требует обсуждения constraints, не automatic approval. Documentation полезна, но joint exploration быстрее снимает несовместимые assumptions.

s06.1|Now that the data-layer dependency is explicit, let's compare a feasible smaller design and the larger investment, adding early technical discovery to future planning.|I'll accept the rewrite cost as unavoidable and postpone the sprint, since preserving the approved design is the clearest way to honor the user goal.|I'll cancel the design and ask engineers to choose a simpler interface, avoiding another round of cross-functional debate.|User goal и конкретный design различаются. Joint decision должен учитывать feasibility и scope, не отдавать одной функции весь выбор.

s07.0|I'll propose an accountable checkout outcome owner and shared metric, map decision rights and dependencies, and make the cross-team allocation a leadership choice.|I'll create a weekly checkout meeting with all three teams and keep each team's separate goals and release priorities unchanged.|I'll merge all three teams into one checkout squad immediately, treating ownership ambiguity as proof the organization chart must change.|Meeting не ownership, reorg не единственное решение. Нужны authority и ресурсы под общий outcome.

s07.1|I'll take the competing commitments to the shared sponsor with quantified checkout impact and options.|I'll ask Tom for a small best-efforts contribution and keep his committed goals unchanged, hoping incremental help restarts conversion growth.|I'll set checkout as Tom's top priority myself because it affects the whole business, moving his existing work without sponsor agreement.|Shared outcome требует legitimate prioritization. Best efforts может подойти для discovery, но не заменяет funded delivery commitment.

s08.0|I'll compare reachable demand, customer need, unit economics and execution constraints against deepening the current market, using a small test where uncertainty matters most.|I'll recommend the new market because it is three times larger, using current forty-percent growth as evidence we can replicate the model.|I'll deepen the current market because forty-percent growth shows there is no reason to accept expansion risk.|TAM не obtainable demand. Текущий рост тоже не гарантирует лучший marginal return; нужна evidence о следующей инвестиции.

s08.1|I'll give a conditional recommendation with the known economics, material unknowns and a reversible learning milestone, distinguishing a direction decision from full investment approval.|I'll choose a direction now and fill evidence gaps afterward, presenting a confident narrative because the board asked for a decision this week.|I'll refuse to recommend anything until the full market study is complete, even if leadership can authorize a bounded discovery investment.|Срок не создаёт certainty. Useful recommendation может быть ограниченным решением с explicit assumptions и stop/go gate.

s09.0|I'll discuss the two delayed projects with the PM, separate planning, dependency and execution causes, and agree supported expectations and review dates.|I'll reduce the PM's project load immediately and give the remaining deadlines to a stronger colleague, postponing feedback until delivery stabilizes.|I'll issue a formal warning based on two one-month delays, treating the schedule variance as sufficient evidence of individual underperformance.|Outcome — сигнал для investigation. Без контекста нельзя ни обвинить человека, ни скрыть ожидания поддержкой без plan.

s09.1|Let's examine dated priority changes and your escalation choices, agree what leadership must stabilize and what you own, then review progress against that shared plan.|I'll accept the explanation and pause performance feedback until leadership stops changing priorities, removing personal accountability for the delayed projects.|I'll keep the same goals and ask the PM to be more resilient, treating leadership volatility as a normal part of product management.|System issues и individual agency могут сосуществовать. Нужны конкретные изменения по обеим сторонам, не полное снятие или игнорирование ответственности.

s10.0|I'll map shared outcomes, capacity and dependencies across the three roadmaps, then agree an explicit portfolio sequence and what stops with the relevant owners.|I'll combine all three roadmaps into one list and ask engineering to choose the delivery order using its capacity knowledge.|I'll prioritize the project with the largest revenue estimate and leave the other PMs to renegotiate their dates directly with each other.|Engineering оценивает feasibility, но value trade-off требует product authority. Один revenue forecast без uncertainty и dependencies недостаточен.

s10.1|Let's align the dependency contract, required date and fallback options with both owners, escalating the portfolio trade-off if their commitments genuinely conflict.|I'll ask the PM to increase status-meeting frequency until the other team provides a reliable date for the blocked work.|I'll remove the dependency from this quarter's plan and require the PM to deliver using the current API, before assessing whether that is possible.|Больше reporting не capacity. Fallback нужен technical assessment; shared commitments требуют взаимного владельца и escalation route.

s11.0|I'll draft the customer problem, strategic choices and measurable outcomes with explicit assumptions, then use the four days to align decisions.|I'll merge existing executive ideas into a three-year roadmap, ensuring every sponsor sees their proposed initiative represented in the vision.|I'll publish only a broad aspiration and defer all choices until strategy is clear, avoiding any concrete statement that might change later.|Vision не feature inventory и не empty slogan. Можно обозначить choices и unknowns без фиктивного detailed three-year forecast.

s11.1|I'll ask which assumptions and risks drive the disagreement, compare concrete scenarios and clarify stable ambition versus adaptable execution commitments.|I'll split the difference between the two executive positions, reducing each target until both sides describe the vision as acceptable.|I'll keep the most ambitious version because a vision should stretch the company, leaving feasibility debates to annual planning.|Consensus по среднему не стратегия. Ambition и execution следует связать с evidence и capacity, не противопоставлять.

s12.0|I'll diagnose the checkout and onboarding collisions, map customer journeys and decision boundaries, then pilot an ownership model before committing to a company-wide reorganization.|I'll organize entirely by segment because customer focus is stronger than feature ownership, assuming shared platform collisions will resolve inside each segment.|I'll organize entirely by feature because technical boundaries are clearer, making end-to-end journey coordination the responsibility of weekly meetings.|Structure выбирают по dependency и outcomes. Ни segment, ни feature label не устраняет shared-system ownership автоматически.

s12.1|I'll connect funded outcome areas, spans and capability gaps to a capacity plan, comparing hiring with clearer ownership and reduced work before requesting headcount.|I'll hire one PM per engineering squad next year, applying the same ratio across platform, discovery and customer-facing teams.|I'll hire as many PMs as the approved budget allows and let them identify valuable problems after joining.|Ratio — benchmark, не обоснование роли. Дополнительный PM тоже требует scope, onboarding и support; capacity не только бюджет.

s13.0|I'll reconcile the twelve-percent gap by drivers and forecast assumptions, distinguish controllable contributions and propose actions with ranges.|I'll attribute the miss to sales execution and market conditions, emphasizing that product delivered its planned feature scope on time.|I'll commit to recover the full twelve percent next quarter, using a stretch roadmap to demonstrate ownership before validating the revenue levers.|Ownership не full attribution и не unsupported promise. On-time outputs не объясняют outcomes; нужны evidence и revised forecast.

s13.1|I'll show changed assumptions, leading indicators and checkpoint evidence, state residual risk and define when we adjust the plan.|I'll add weekly board reporting and personally approve every roadmap change, using tighter oversight as proof the revenue forecast will hold.|I'll present only the conservative forecast so future results are likely to exceed it, restoring credibility through managed expectations.|Cadence не proof, sandbagging не honest forecast. Trust строят проверяемыми assumptions, progress и ясными corrective triggers.

s14.0|I'll assess product overlap, customer commitments, data and integration risk, strategic fit and alternatives, separating deal value from an assumption that every product survives.|I'll recommend keeping every product for one year after acquisition, using continuity as the default.|I'll prioritize the buyer's revenue synergies and let legal handle all customer and data concerns after the commercial agreement is signed.|Deal thesis не отменяет obligations. Universal freeze и premature cuts оба требуют evidence и authority.

s14.1|I'll compare forward contribution, remaining investment and customer migration obligations, recommending scenarios and decision criteria.|I'll cut the least profitable products immediately, assuming current margin captures their strategic and customer value to the combined company.|I'll leave all product-retirement decisions to the buyer and avoid a recommendation, since the acquisition would transfer final authority.|Нужна recommendation с evidence даже при чужом final approval. Negative current margin не равен negative future strategic value.

b31.0|I'll assess the export defect's severity, exposure and verified workaround against release criteria, then obtain explicit risk acceptance or a scoped exclusion with a fix owner.|I'll ship because two percent is a small affected group and a workaround exists, placing the fix into the next sprint's general backlog.|I'll block the whole release because any known defect invalidates quality, regardless of severity, workaround or the announcement dependency.|Доля пользователей не severity. Нужны affected journey, financial/privacy impact и authorized acceptance, не универсальный процент.

b32.0|Four to five percent is one percentage point or twenty-five percent relative; I'll add the interval and design limits before calling the observed difference a proven improvement.|I'll announce a twenty-five-percent improvement because the arithmetic is correct, leaving significance and test maturity for the technical report.|I'll announce a one-percent improvement to avoid exaggeration, treating percentage points and relative percent as interchangeable conservative wording.|Арифметика relative верна, certainty отдельно. “One percent” не то же, что one percentage point; неделя и1500 без design не подтверждают effect.

b33.0|I'll state June as an unconfirmed target, offer an assessed integration scope and estimation checkpoint, and align sales before any contractual promise.|I'll promise June with a best-efforts clause and ask engineering to prioritize the integration after the prospect signs.|I'll refuse to discuss June until the full specification is complete, even if a limited discovery commitment could move the deal forward.|Disclaimer не делает unlikely date credible. Useful next commitment может быть discovery, не молчание или неподтверждённая дата.

b34.0|I'll ask which new objective or evidence changed the priority, show the retention work displaced and seek an explicit trade-off before interrupting the sprint.|I'll add the competitor feature because the CEO owns strategy, keeping the retention commitment listed as an unchanged stretch target.|I'll reject it using last month's priority statement, treating an approved strategy as a reason not to discuss new information.|Strategy может меняться, capacity нет автоматически. Leadership decision должен быть осознанным и reflected в commitments.

b35.0|I'll involve the incident/release owners, verify a fix or scoped containment and pause the affected launch path until sign-up integrity meets the agreed release criteria.|I'll launch with a warning asking users to shorten their email addresses, treating the three-percent group as a manageable support exception.|I'll cancel every marketing activity immediately and move the whole release one month, before assessing the fix or targeted exclusion.|Core acquisition failure требует severity-based response. Public invitation не оправдывает broken sign-up; date shift должен быть proportionate evidence.

b36.0|I'll check response bias and usage definitions, compare respondents with nonrespondents and investigate declining behavior.|I'll quote eighty-percent satisfaction in the company update and discuss falling usage separately because opinions and behavior are independent success measures.|I'll discard the survey entirely because only five percent answered, assuming all low-response surveys are useless.|Low response сам по себе не доказанный bias, но composition важна. Findings полезны в пределах population; conflicting signals требуют reconciliation.
